enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes steadily. Turns to left side. Moves legs. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket. Fan runs. Remains still. Turns to right side. Moves arm. Continues sleeping. Turns again. Adjusts blanket.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, getting dressed, and packing a bag with laptop and notes for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to wardrobe. Opens wardrobe door. Takes out clothes. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Walks to desk. Picks up laptop. Puts laptop in bag. Picks up notes. Puts notes in bag. Zips bag. Closes wardrobe door. Walks to bedroom door.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Lifts toilet lid. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Lowers lid. Walks to sink. Turns on tap. Wets hands. Picks up soap. Rubs hands. Puts soap down. Rinses hands. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Wipes face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, toasting bread, and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Turns on kettle. Opens bread bag. Takes out two slices. Places slices in toaster. Pushes toaster lever down. Waits. Kettle boils. Pours hot water into mug. Adds tea bag. Toaster pops. Removes toast. Places toast on plate. Spreads butter. Eats toast. Drinks tea. Washes plate. Washes mug. Puts away.
Walks out of house. Closes door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Rides bus. Gets off bus. Walks to office. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community program schedules, answering emails, and preparing session materials
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Makes phone calls. Sends emails. Opens document. Edits document. Prints document. Collates materials. Staples packets. Places packets in folder. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Talks to colleagues.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to cafe. Enters cafe. Orders food. Pays. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Wipes mouth with napkin. Throws away trash. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: meeting partner organisations, updating program records, and planning upcoming community events
enriched_activities.desc: Sits in meeting room. Greets partners. Shakes hands. Opens laptop. Takes notes. Discusses plans. Nods head. Types notes. Closes laptop. Stands up. Walks to desk. Opens database. Updates records. Types information. Saves file. Opens calendar. Schedules events. Makes calls. Sends invitations.
Packs bag. Walks out of office. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits. Rides bus. Gets off. Walks home. Opens door. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating dinner with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Greets Member 2. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out meat. Places on counter. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs with spatula. Adds meat. Stirs. Adds spices. Turns off cooker. Places food on plates. Sets table. Calls Member 2. Sits down. Eats dinner. Talks with Member 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up plates. Scrapes food into bin. Places plates in sink. Turns on tap. Squeezes dish soap. Scrubs plates with sponge. Rinses plates. Places plates in drying rack. Picks up glasses. Washes glasses. Rinses. Places in rack. Wipes counter with cloth. Throws away trash. Dries hands. Talks with Member 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Puts remote down. Watches TV. Talks with Member 2. Laughs. Leans back. Adjusts cushion. Continues watching.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower with the water heater
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Waits for water to heat. Takes off clothes. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Wets body. Picks up soap. Lathers body. Rinses. Picks up shampoo. Washes hair. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer at the desk lamp to catch up on personal admin and browse
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens browser. Checks email. Replies to personal emails. Opens banking website. Pays bills. Transfers money. Opens social media. Browses feed. Watches videos. Closes browser. Opens document. Writes notes. Saves document. Closes laptop. Turns off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening routine: brushing teeth and washing face before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Puts toothbrush down. Turns on tap. Wets face. Picks up soap. Washes face. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Turns off light. Lies on bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Fan runs. Breathes steadily. Turns to side. Remains asleep. Turns again. Moves arm. Continues sleeping. Adjusts blanket. Fan oscillates.
